name: hearthboard
description: Drag-and-drop family wallboard: two-way Apple + Google calendars, Apple Reminders, Synology Photos, verse/quote and checklists.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p web --noEmit
